title: Microsoft Posts Biggest One-Day Market-Cap Gain for Any U.S. Company
summary: Tension between Silicon Valley’s astronomical AI spending and Wall Street fears that it won’t pay off had been sending markets on a wild ride.  The company’s stock surged 16% after its earnings quelled concerns that investments on data centers, chips and more would outpace the company’s ability to generate cash.  Microsoft’s $450 billion one-day gain in market capitalization was the largest by any U.S. business, ever.
